settings.heading: Custom Engraved Awards & Gifts for Schools and Public Agencies
settings.text:
Elma Vada Studio provides custom engraved awards, personalized pens, glassware and promotional products for schools, universities, government agencies and community organizations.

With in-house laser engraving in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas, we help coordinate organization logos, individual names, quantities and delivery requirements for recognition programs and public-sector purchasing.

Planning an appreciation event or preparing a formal purchasing request? Send us your project details or RFQ/RFP requirements for review.

settings.question: Can each item have a different name?
settings.answer: Yes. Eligible products can carry individual names, titles, service years or recognition messages within one coordinated order. Send your recipient list and personalization requirements.

settings.question: Can you engrave our school or agency logo?
settings.answer: Yes, on compatible products. We review the artwork, engraving placement and design details before production. Digital proofs can be provided for approval.

settings.question: Is there a minimum order quantity?
settings.answer: Many products are available without a minimum order quantity. Specialty items, larger orders and custom sourcing projects are quoted according to availability and specifications.

settings.question: Can you respond to our RFQ or RFP?
settings.answer: We review solicitations relevant to our products and services. Send the requirements and deadline so we can determine whether we can submit a suitable quotation or proposal.

settings.question: How long will production take?
settings.answer: Timing depends on the products, quantity, inventory and artwork approval. Production and shipping schedules are confirmed with your quote; share your required delivery date when you contact us.

settings.question: Can you deliver to several campuses or offices?
settings.answer: We can review requests for multiple delivery locations. Include the quantities for each destination so packaging, shipping and associated costs can be included in your quote.
